note: Derived inputs are NOT fetched; they are recomputed deterministically from pinned sources. These digests are the contract: scripts/build_concentration.py rebuilds each prior and refuses to use a different one. Digest = sha256(shape str + float32 payload).

source.license: USGS/NBMG Geothermal Data Repository, public domain (US Government work); pinned as 'prior layer only' in registry/data_manifest.json

steps: keep rows whose thermalclass contains Hot or Warm
de-duplicate to one feature per (row, col) grid cell (records are measurements, not features)
prior = exp(-d / sigma_px), d = Euclidean distance in cells to the nearest kept feature
set NaN outside the sample_submission footprint

diagnostics.consistency_check: median distance recomputed from the pinned catalogue equals the CSV's own dist_known_fault_px column (17.2 px), so both refer to the same catalogue raster

strain_priors.derivation: src/gems91/strain.py: EDT nearest-cell fill of Sentinel (<= -1e30)/non-finite cells inside footprint (3,061 px per band), average-tie percentile rank over footprint, prior = 0.5*pct(band4 geod_2ndinv)+0.5*pct(band7 geod_shearrate), NaN outside footprint
src/gems91/strain.py: same fill/rank; prior = pct(band8 geod_dilaterate), high percentile = most positive
